activity_summary: You told her the comedy is off the stage, that the Queen's twenty pounds was the company's and not your wage, and that the Lord Mayor has never spoken to you. You gave her the canvas sewn, eighteen shillings and not sixty, and you named the three shops inside the five pounds. She weighed it unopened and named malt, corn, and shoes, one pair fewer. She said it is the one leather. You did not name a house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Told the comedy, the Queen's money, the Mayor, and the eighteen, and named no house.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Weighed the canvas, named the uses, and made the shoemakers one leather.

facets.activity: Gave her eighteen shillings and heard malt, corn, and shoes

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Your father's shoemaker or ours, Will, it's the one leather.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Shoes, one pair fewer than the sixty would have bought.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not adding a house to either sentence.
